rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for pneumonia, including infection-related inflammation of the lungs.

example.english: The doctor said I have pneumonia and need to stay in the hospital for a few days.
example.traditional: 醫生話我係肺炎，要留院幾日。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ngo5 hai6 fai3 jim4 jiu3 lau4 jyun2 gei2 jat6
